head.t: Nervecentre unveils a single EPR for primary and secondary care
head.x: Nervecentre launched what it calls the UK's first single EPR platform for primary and secondary care at an event in London on 11 November. It says GP practices and hospitals can work from one record, with new AI tools (NiO) that draft record entries and follow-up tasks for clinician approval.
